messages:
alex: quick RFC followup — I want to float a small interop shim called 'signal-bridge' that sits between rollout controller and router. goal: standardize probe envelopes and a tiny decision vocabulary so ops/runtime aren't arguing over 10 different probe formats. keep it minimal and opt-in.

priya: love smaller surfaces. what's in the envelope? fields + semantics?

alex: ProbeEnvelope = {probe_type, metric, weight, ts_ms, source, seq, sample_rate}. weight is [0..1] so adapters can express confidence. routers aggregate weighted samples and emit decisions: allow, throttle_pct, eject.

dan: how do we stop noisy adapters from flooding the bridge with redundant events?

alex: two mitigations: 1) adapters attach sample_rate and we treat each event as representing 1/sample_rate real events; 2) bridge runs a per-source probabilistic dedupe using a small bloom + ttl keyed by (source, seq). cheap and bounded.

emily: bloom adds FP risk — could suppress a legit spike. acceptable?

alex: we bias bloom params to favor false positives slightly (better to ignore duplicates than overreact), but we also require decision thresholds to need sustained signal for N windows before eject.

priya: decision latency expectations? we need sub-250ms for short failures.

\alex: target: ingestion->decision <200ms for short window rules (under 500ms under tail load). bridge is in-router fastpath (lock-free ring buffer). slow-path archives raw envelopes async.

\dan: sample policy? could you paste a JSON example we can smell-test?

alex: here you go:

```json
{
  "id": "sb-default",
  "probe_types": ["p95_latency_ms","http_5xx_ratio","semantic-drift"],
  "windows": [
    {"name":"short","dur_ms":8000,"threshold":2.0,"action":"throttle_pct","param":50},
    {"name":"stabilize","dur_ms":60000,"threshold":1.2,"action":"eject","param":0}
  ],
  "consensus": {"min_sources":2,"min_samples":30},
  "dedupe_ttl_ms":300,
  "bloom_fp_target":0.01
}
```

priya: consensus bit is interesting. says we want at least 2 independent probe sources before eject. good for avoiding single-sensor flaps.

emily: ops needs an emergency takeover — immediate eject + pager. how is that wired?

\alex: controller has an ops-latch API: POST /rollouts/{id}/latch?action=eject&reason=ops. router honors latch immediately (sync write to control plane) and emits a high-priority telemetry event. also optional rollback auto-timestamp.

\dan: what about model-quality probes (semantic-drift)? they're expensive and low-Q. how do we prevent them from dominating decisions?

\alex: require quality probes to include a baseline_hash and sample_count; bridge computes a drift_score only once sample_count>min and drift_score>absolute_delta + relative_delta to qualify. also quality probes have lower default weight (0.2).

priya: fault tolerance: if bridge OOMs/crashes, we can't block router.

\alex: bridge life-cycle: in-process soft mode uses bounded memory; if memory pressure detected it flips to passthrough conservative mode where we emit p95-based heuristic decisions and tombstone the in-memory state. all writes to control-plane are async and nonblocking.

emily: how do we validate correctness before flipping on? I'd like a shadow/compare mode.

\alex: router supports mode=shadow where bridge computes decisions and emits intended_action to telemetry but does not change routing. we suggest 48h shadowing plus a replay harness: small replay driver that feeds recorded envelopes and compares actions across parameter sweeps.

\dan: perf numbers? we need to know p99 add.

\alex: local bench: in-process bridge adds ~70ns per envelope on a 64-core box when ring-buffer fastpath used. bloom op amortized ~0.6us for insertion/lookup at our target fp. overall p99 add under normal load ~0.9%.

priya: telemetry schema so SRE can stitch to traces?

\alex: emit events tagged with {rollout_id, variant, bridge_version, probe_type, decision, reason_code, confidence}. also attach sample_id for replay. raw envelopes go to long-term store (sampling at 1%).

emily: testing + rollout plan?

\alex: RFC addendum + small proto impl in router; feature-flagged behind rollout-bridge-ff. plan: internal dogfood on non-critical traffic for 1 week, then tiered enable per region. will include unit tests, integration tests with controller, and a sim harness to exercise hysteresis and consensus.

infra-bot: checklist ticket created: https://internal.redwood/ops/checks/SB-13 (auto-created).

\dan: nice. can you add a short section in the RFC about expected false positive/negative tradeoffs and recommended adapter defaults?

\alex: yes will add that and a recommended adapter SDK patch to help adapters set sample_rate/weight. planning a walkthrough w/ runtime + eng-sre Fri 10am. @priya @dan @emily can you review the addendum by Thu EOD?

priya: will review.

\dan: thumbs up.

emily: on it. also please include quickstart for running shadow mode locally.

\alex: done, thanks all :shipit:
